title: Swim CSS Calculator
description: Critical swim speed from your 400 m and 200 m time trials, plus training zones.
howto: Swim an all-out 400 m time trial and record the time.
Rest, then swim an all-out 200 m time trial and record it.
Read your CSS pace per 100 m and the training zone paces around it.

faqs.a: The fastest pace you can theoretically hold aerobically, estimated here as (400m time minus 200m time) divided by 2, per 100 m.

faqs.q: Why must the 400 m be slower per 100 m than the 200 m?
faqs.a: If it is not, at least one trial was not a true maximal effort, and the estimate is invalid.

faqs.q: How do I use the zones?
faqs.a: Train mostly at CSS plus a few seconds (aerobic), touch CSS pace for threshold sets, and go faster for sprint work.
